correctness.rationale: The factorization criterion for \(p\mid\varphi(m)\) is exact. The cases \(p\nmid A\) and \(p\mid A, B\not\equiv1\pmod p\) produce a prime witness by CRT plus Dirichlet. In the remaining case, two reduced residue classes \(c,d\pmod A\) satisfy \(cd\equiv B\pmod A\) while both avoid \(1\pmod p\); distinct prime representatives therefore give a squarefree semiprime whose totient is not divisible by \(p\). These cases exhaust all coprime \(A,B\). The packaged checker independently verifies all coprime \(A,B\le35\) for odd primes \(p\le19\).
